byjoba.com.title: byJoBa
byjoba.com.pageTitle: byJoBa — software and hardware by Jonas Barsten
byjoba.com.description: byJoBa is the name Jonas Barsten puts on the software and hardware he makes in Oslo: apps and services, music tools for Ableton Live, and hardware.
byjoba.com.intro: byJoBa stands for by Jonas Barsten: software and hardware.

jsonLd.name: byJoBa
jsonLd.description: Software and hardware made by Jonas Barsten.

jonasbarsten.com.title: Jonas Barsten
jonasbarsten.com.pageTitle: Jonas Barsten — musician and developer in Oslo
jonasbarsten.com.description: Jonas Barsten is a drummer, musical director and developer in Oslo. A list of his work in music, teaching, spaces, installations, software and hardware.
jonasbarsten.com.intro: Musician in Oslo. I like making things: software, hardware and rooms for culture.

projects.name: Jotufa
projects.summary: Invite-only event platform where the ticket is tied to the person.
projects.about: iOS, Android and web clients on a serverless AWS backend.

projects.name: Fiken MCP
projects.summary: MCP server that connects the Fiken accounting API to Claude and ChatGPT.
projects.about: Books receipts from a photo, sends invoices and answers questions about the accounts. Stores nothing on the server. MIT licensed.

projects.name: Fakfura
projects.summary: Invoice generator for the phone. Makes a PDF and hands it to the share sheet.
projects.about: In Norwegian. Runs in the browser.

projects.name: Suril
projects.summary: iOS app that turns a written dream into scenes and generates the images on the device.

projects.name: Huba (working title)
projects.summary: Distributed file system for audio, video and image work.

projects.name: TBC
projects.summary: Unannounced. TypeScript monorepo on AWS with CDK and DynamoDB.

projects.name: Create X Tracks
projects.summary: Creates a batch of audio or MIDI tracks for multitrack recording, with inputs and outputs routed in sequence to the audio interface.
projects.about: Mono or stereo, with an optional name prefix. A review step shows each track's channels before anything is created.

projects.name: Track Export
projects.summary: Saves the selected Arrangement tracks as a new Live Set in the same project folder, leaving the original untouched.
projects.about: Needs the byJoBa Live Extension Helper, a menu-bar app for macOS that does the file work an extension is not allowed to do.

projects.name: Upload to Dropbox
projects.summary: Uploads an audio clip from the Arrangement to a Dropbox folder.

projects.name: Upload to Samply
projects.summary: Renders an audio clip from the Arrangement and uploads it to a Samply project.

projects.name: Set Location
projects.summary: Shows the file path of the Live Set that is open.
projects.about: Needs the byJoBa Live Extension Helper.

projects.name: Sordello
projects.summary: Subprojects for Ableton Live: a group track becomes its own set, and its bounce comes back.
projects.about: A macOS app and a Max for Live device.

projects.name: Cantica
projects.summary: Multitrack mixer and recorder for iPad and Mac.

projects.name: SMPTE Timecode Generator
projects.summary: macOS app that writes SMPTE LTC timecode as WAV files.

projects.name: Kiwi
projects.summary: Headless instrument on a Raspberry Pi: piano, sampler and vocoder at once, blended with MIDI knobs.

projects.name: Vigil
projects.summary: Door access system: an ESP32 device with a maglock, a cloud API and apps.

projects.name: Minos
projects.summary: Networked MIDI routing for live rigs: a desktop routing matrix and PoE boxes with MIDI ports.

projects.name: Drums and Electronics
projects.summary: Master's thesis at the Norwegian Academy of Music: drums with electronics controlled by sensors on a dancer.
projects.about: With dancers Anette Boge and Hedvig Bang.

projects.name: Ableton Certified Trainer
projects.summary: Teaches Live, Push and Max for Live. The only certified trainer in Norway.

projects.name: OLYP
projects.summary: Musicians' collective at Rosenhoff in Oslo: 32 rehearsal and production rooms in about 3,000 m².

projects.name: Rooms at OLYP
projects.summary: Sound-isolated rehearsal and production rooms, built on site.

projects.name: olyp.no
projects.summary: Administration software for production premises: rooms, tenants and billing.

projects.name: Rosenhall
projects.summary: Concert venue and bar at Rosenhoff in Oslo, in a converted bomb shelter with room for 250.
projects.about: A meeting place by day for the musicians who work in the area, a venue and bar by night.

projects.name: Resonance
projects.summary: Technology for the preliminary phase of Gunhild Mathea Olaussen's sound installation: copper speaker membranes around twelve sensor-activated string columns.
projects.about: The preliminary version was shown at the Norwegian Theatre Academy in 2016. The finished work, with technology by Roar Sletteland and Bernt Isak Wærstad, was shown at Henie Onstad Art Centre during Ultima in 2019 and at Galleri F 15 in 2020.

projects.name: Puffene
projects.summary: Control software for the nine light and speaker boxes in Almir og Puffene, a music narrative for children by accordionist Almir Meskovic.
projects.about: Each box has sensors, lights and a speaker, and is controlled over OSC from Ableton Live. Boxes designed by Kyrre Heldal Karlsen. Produced by Ragnhild Tveitan for Viken DKS.

projects.name: byJoBa
projects.summary: What I make on my own initiative: apps and services, music tools, and hardware. Listed at byjoba.com.

projects.name: Tour Control
projects.summary: App for artists and crews on tour: schedule, venues, travel, contacts and chat.
projects.about: For FKP Scorpio Norge. iOS and web clients on a serverless backend.

projects.name: YourBuzzKollekt
projects.summary: Web platform for Buzz Kollekt that gathers ticket, advertising, newsletter and streaming data.

projects.name: BuzzMail

projects.name: highasakite.no
projects.summary: Highasakite's website and the ticket site for their church tour, for Buzz Kollekt.

projects.name: Solibo
projects.summary: Board portal for housing companies.
projects.about: My part has ended. The portal is still in use.

projects.name: VIER.LIVE
projects.summary: Platform for streaming concerts with paid tickets and viewer chat.

projects.name: Zahn Hello
projects.summary: Raspberry Pi video walls with cameras and a live video link, for Zahn.

projects.name: Veslesampler
projects.summary: The mixer for the children's music project Meg og kammeraten min: change the balance between the instruments and record your own vocals.
projects.about: First built as a standalone app in Max in 2021, later as a mixer that runs in the browser.

projects.name: Artist and label websites
projects.summary: Websites for Atlanter, Daniel Kvammen, Jansen Records, Hajk, Blackpop Records and others.

projects.name: Innspill til kulturarenastrategien
projects.summary: Written submission from OLYP to the government's strategy for culture venues.
projects.about: Asks for multi-year operating support for culture production premises, a VAT arrangement for them, a study of returning a share of ticket income, guarantee and loan schemes, a place for culture production in municipal planning, and a municipal contact person.

projects.name: Association for culture production premises
projects.summary: Interest organisation for those who run rehearsal and production premises.
